You receive 4 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Images 2-3 are photos of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 4 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: the yard side of the primary school ZŠ Sokolíkova 2 in Dúbravka, Bratislava (opened 1974), seen from its school yard. Image 2 is a photo of the same school building from its street side: the 1970s typified school with long horizontal ribbon windows with many slim vertical mullions, horizontal wall bands between the window rows, a flat roof with a plain attic edge and an entrance with a slim steel canopy and concrete steps - paint the yard side with exactly this architecture, but NOT its grey mosaic cladding and NOT its white plastic windows: in 1995 the walls are one single plain colour, a smooth pale yellowish (light ochre-cream) render, slightly weathered, and the windows are the original 1970s ones with slim white-painted frames. Image 3 shows the greenery and the low concrete walls of the same housing estate (mood and materials only).

Brief: the school yard in June 1995: playground asphalt, a bench under a linden, an art panel with four shapes and a rhythmic drawing. Warm early-summer afternoon light from the left, fresh green trees, a clear sky.

Camera: standing on the yard asphalt, about 2.1 m high, looking across the yard at the long yard facade; vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon is at y ~380. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the three-storey building (ground floor with a row of square piers and dark recessed glazing, above it two long ribbon-window floors) recedes from the left edge (roof edge y 80, foot y 451) to its far end at x 1250 (roof edge y 180, foot y 428); it stands on top of a grass bank that slopes down to the yard (bank foot y 507 at the left, y 465 at x 1250); the yard entrance - a glazed double door with a small flat steel canopy, a concrete landing and a concrete path down the bank - is at x 868-924; every prop of the yard stands on the asphalt with its foot at y ~700; the yard asphalt runs from the bank foot to the bottom edge.

What the sketch blocks are, left to right: the long school facade with its ribbon windows, the small yard door and the path down the grass bank; behind the school the wooded hill of Dúbravka with a few small family houses among the trees; at the right, behind the far end of the school, a tall poplar, the trees of the housing estate and a tall yellowish panel block with balcony bands; in front of them the tall see-through steel-mesh fence of the multi-sport court on a low concrete base, the big lawn and the red clay athletics track curving across the right half; on the yard: a small grass bed with a low kerb at the back edge of the yard, the young linden growing in it, a wooden bench with concrete legs under the linden, the low red-brick service wall with a concrete coping and its inset panel of grey stones, the red water-pipe elbow at the wall's right end, the basketball pole.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 196-396, y 436-580 of the 1920x1080 frame (10-21 % from the left, 40-54 % from the top): a freestanding painted plywood art panel on two thin steel posts at the left edge of the yard, made by pupils: four big simple shapes in bright colours along the top (a red circle, a blue triangle, a yellow square, a purple zigzag shape) and under them a rhythmic pattern - three green waves, two black strokes, six small red pieces - with no letters and no digits.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 1535-1705, y 255-380 of the 1920x1080 frame (80-89 % from the left, 24-35 % from the top): the white basketball backboard with a red square and an orange hoop ring WITHOUT a net, on a grey steel pole standing at the right edge of the asphalt in front of the track.
3. the block of the layout sketch at x 530-710, y 170-690 of the 1920x1080 frame (28-37 % from the left, 16-64 % from the top): the young linden tree in its grass bed: a thin, weak, damaged little tree - a slim slightly leaning trunk with a scraped bark scar low on the trunk, a few thin branches and a sparse crown with gaps and some yellowish leaves; it clearly struggles.
The inset stone panel of the brick wall is a grid of 3 rows x 4 columns of grey stone blocks, all in place and flush (no hole). The red pipe elbow rises from the ground and bends sideways towards the wall, ending in a flange.

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 722-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top) is the worn grey asphalt of the school yard - one continuous flat surface with no kerb, no step, no edge and no change of material inside it, and nothing standing on it: no balls, no bins, no bicycles, no poles. Only light, soft leaf shadows, a few faded white painted court lines and old patches in the asphalt. The asphalt continues out of the left edge along the facade (the area of the layout sketch at x 0-60, y 722-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)) and out of the right edge past the track (the area of the layout sketch at x 1860-1920, y 722-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (97-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)).
NPC zone at x 738-862, y 517-795 of the 1920x1080 frame (38-45 % from the left, 48-74 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 795.
Fixed architectural anchor 'building_corner' at x 1250, y 180. Fixed architectural anchor 'tree_trunk' at x 620, y 690. Fixed architectural anchor 'service_niche' at x 1155, y 626. Fixed architectural anchor 'pipe_axis' at x 1382, y 705.

Fiction rules: the bench, linden, wall, pipe, art panel and hoop are game props; no real pupils or staff. 1995: no murals, no graffiti, no modern plastic windows, no satellite dishes, no modern play equipment, no cars. No house numbers, no names, no school name, no signs, no logos, no lettering of any kind, no people in the windows or anywhere, no animals.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
